phenotype_specificity.statement: Per-person clinical detail is not given; the survey reports cardiomyopathy in all patients and myopathy in all male patients (cohort-level). Testing of other genes is not reported.

quotes.quote: Myopathy was usually mild and was observed in all male patients.

segregation.statement: Table 1 lists the mother as affected; her genotype is not reported.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Single-base substitution predicted to change one amino acid (p.(Leu19Pro)) in exon 1. Table 1 nonetheless labels its effect 'Frame shift', and the text says every survey mutation except Family 5's was nonsense or frameshift. Authors state Danon disease is caused by loss-of-function variants.

quotes.quote: | 15 | E1 | c.56T>C | Frame shift | proband | mother | [18] |
All mutations were either nonsense or frame-shift mutations that are predicted to cause truncation of the protein, except for the exon 6 skipping mutation in Family 5.
Danon disease is primarily caused by loss-of-function mutations in the LAMP-2 gene.

population_data_in_papers.statement: Cohort-level statement: none of the survey's mutations was found in 100 Japanese controls.

quotes.quote: On screening 100 Japanese controls, the same mutations were not found.

concerns: The genotype of Family 15 is internally inconsistent in 30413001: Table 1 gives c.56T>C, but the text says Family 15 shares c.877C > T with Family 11.

Table 1 labels c.56T>C 'Frame shift', which does not fit a single-base substitution; the text says all survey mutations were nonsense or frameshift except an exon 6 skipping variant. The c. string, the effect label or both may be wrong in the table.
If c.56T>C is correct it would be a single amino-acid change, a class the papers in this batch describe as rare in Danon disease; no functional or segregation data are given.
Survey table only; the source is reference [18] (Namatame 2015, a Japanese-language report not in this batch).
30413001 gives two different counts for families whose mothers or relatives tested negative (eight families in Results, 10 families in Discussion) and does not say which families these are.
30413001 states no transcript and no protein change; c. numbering cannot be checked against NM_002294.3 from this paper alone.
notes_for_panel: 30413001 is a nationwide questionnaire survey; per-family information is limited to Table 1 (site, cDNA change, effect on mRNA, affected relatives, source reference). It gives no transcript, no protein change and no per-person phenotype table.
